facts.fact: The Bank Al-Maghrib report on exercise 2023 calls Maroc Digital 2030 the future strategy, with which the second phase of the financial inclusion strategy would gain by aligning; the report prints no writing date, so the exercise year is used.

note: Class is left empty: the report names Maroc Digital 2030 but does not describe its scope. The financial inclusion strategy is outside the study's field.
